# KomikoAI

> > KomikoAI is an AI-powered platform for creating comics, manga, manhwa, and webtoons with tools for expression editing, image animation, relighting, and talking head generation.

KomikoAI provides a comprehensive suite of AI tools for comic creators and anime artists, including story-to-comic generation, facial expression editing, image-to-video animation, and portrait enhancement. The platform hosts the AniGen competition for short-form AI animation in partnership with Hedra and Hailuo.

## Key Topics

- AI comic generation
- Manga and manhwa creation
- Facial expression editing
- AI animation (image-to-video)
- Webtoon tools
- AI talking head generation
- Portrait editing and relighting
- Story-to-comic conversion
- AniGen competition
- Vertical animation format
- AI art generation
- Beginner-friendly comic tools
- Anime-style content creation
- AI-powered character animation
- Comic creation workflow

## Core AI Tools

- [AI Comic Generator - KomikoAI](https://komiko.app/create/generate): KomikoAI's main AI comic generator for creating manga, manhwa from stories
- [AI Expression Changer – KomikoAI](https://komiko.app/ai-expression-changer): AI tool to change facial expressions in portraits, anime, manga, webtoons
- [AI動畫生成器 - KomikoAI](https://komiko.app/zh-TW/image-animation-generator): AI animation generator converting static images to anime videos (Traditional Chinese)
- [AI画像リライト - KomikoAI](https://komiko.app/ja/image-relighting): AI image relighting tool for anime, manga, comic art enhancement (Japanese)
- [AI 말하는 얼굴 - 코미코](https://komiko.app/ko/ai-talking-head): AI talking head generator creating lip-synced videos from photos (Korean)
- [AI Pengubah Ekspresi – KomikoAI](https://komiko.app/id/ai-expression-changer): AI expression editor for anime, manga, webtoon facial emotions (Indonesian)

## Community & Competitions

- [Concurso AniGen - Concurso de Animação IA de Curta Duração | Ganhe $ 6.000 e Assinaturas Gratuitas de Ferramentas de IA](https://komiko.app/pt/anigen-competition): AniGen AI animation competition by KomikoAI, Hedra, Hailuo (Portuguese)
- [การแข่งขัน AniGen - การประกวดแอนิเมชัน AI ขนาดสั้น | ชิงเงินรางวัล 6,000 ดอลลาร์ และสิทธิ์ใช้งานเครื่องมือ AI ฟรี](https://komiko.app/th/anigen-competition): AniGen short-form AI animation contest announcement (Thai)
